title: Anthropic Partners with AMD to Deploy 2 Gigawatts of Compute Infrastructure
summary: Anthropic and AMD announced a multi-year partnership to deploy 2 gigawatts of compute capacity using AMD Instinct MI450 Series GPUs.
content:
Anthropic announced a strategic partnership with AMD to expand its global AI compute infrastructure. The multi-year deal secures up to 2 gigawatts of dedicated compute capacity.

The expansion uses next-generation AMD Instinct MI450 Series GPUs. These processors provide high memory bandwidth and fast inter-chip interconnects for large model training.

Scaling Compute for Claude

Training frontier models requires huge hardware resources. Anthropic will use the new AMD clusters to train future model families. The deployment also supports low-latency inference for enterprise users.

AMD designed the MI450 architecture specifically for high-throughput AI workloads. The new systems reduce power consumption per token compared to older GPU generations.

Securing 2 gigawatts of compute capacity ensures long-term infrastructure stability for frontier model development.

Diversifying Compute Infrastructure

This deal diversifies the hardware supply chain for Anthropic. Relying on multiple hardware vendors reduces deployment bottlenecks and lowers operational risks.

The first cluster will go online later this year. Additional data center capacity will scale continuously through 2028.

Contributor: Alessandro Linzi
